Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages thirty-seven to forty-two, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: following-distance counts, stopping-chart distances and speeds, the written crash-form damage threshold and deadline, railroad sign placement and stopping distances, and crossing statistics are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: none open; the following-distance chart on physical page thirty-eight did not extract and no fact was taken from it, while the stopping-distance chart on physical page thirty-nine extracted as rows of speed and three distances whose thinking-plus-braking sums equal the printed totals, confirming the column order; the injury-crash reporting sentence on physical page forty prints the word of where or is meant and was read as injury or fatal; the railroad pavement-marking and multiple-track sentences span two pages and are cited to one page each.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.
